categories.main_business_segments: China Yongda Automobiles Services Holdings Limited operates primarily in passenger vehicle sales and services, including sales of new and pre-owned vehicles, after-sales services such as repair and maintenance, automobile operating lease services, and distribution of automobile insurance and financial products. The company focuses on luxury and ultra-luxury brands, mid-to-high-end brands, and independent new energy vehicle brands.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages digitalization and AI technologies to enhance operational efficiency and customer experience. It employs a comprehensive battery recycling platform for new energy vehicles, including battery inspection, maintenance, insurance, and repair. The company also integrates digital marketing platforms and a proprietary app to connect online and offline services, and uses data analytics for refined user operations.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are individual and corporate buyers of luxury, ultra-luxury, mid-to-high-end, and new energy passenger vehicles in China. The company also serves customers requiring after-sales services, pre-owned vehicle transactions, and automobile leasing. Its market includes first- and second-tier cities and provincial capitals in China, focusing on affluent consumers and new energy vehicle users.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China, with a focus on first- and second-tier cities and provincial capital cities. It manages a network of 221 outlets including 4S dealerships and showrooms for various brands. The headquarters is in Shanghai, with a principal place of business in Hong Kong, and subsidiaries spread across multiple provinces in China.
categories.supply_chain_position: China Yongda operates primarily at the downstream end of the automotive supply chain as a retailer and service provider. It functions as an authorized dealer and service center for automobile manufacturers, providing sales, after-sales services, and vehicle leasing. The company also engages in pre-owned vehicle distribution and emerging battery recycling services, positioning itself as a comprehensive service provider in the automotive retail ecosystem.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus includes accelerating growth in new energy vehicle sales and luxury vehicle distribution, expanding battery recycling and intelligent robot businesses, and embracing AI for digital transformation. It prioritizes network optimization, cost control, talent development, and sustainable operations aligned with national low-carbon policies. R&D efforts emphasize AI applications in business management and customer service to improve quality and efficiency.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through sales of new and pre-owned vehicles, after-sales repair and maintenance services, automobile operating lease services, and commissions from related services such as insurance and financing. The company also earns brokerage income from vehicle sales and leverages digital marketing to drive sales leads. Direct sales and dealership models are used for new energy vehicles.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading passenger vehicle retailer in China, especially in luxury and new energy vehicle segments. It competes with other large automotive dealership groups and new energy vehicle distributors. Its strong brand portfolio, extensive dealership network, and early mover advantage in new energy vehicles position it competitively in the evolving Chinese automotive market.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of RMB63.42 billion, a 14.6% decrease from 2023, with a net profit attributable to owners of RMB201 million, reflecting a significant decline due to market challenges. It sold 171,236 new vehicles and 74,969 pre-owned vehicles in 2024. The company maintains a healthy inventory turnover and a net gearing ratio of 10.3%, with steady cash flow from operations despite a challenging market environment.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: China Yongda emphasizes a dual-track strategy focusing on new energy and luxury vehicles, offering comprehensive sales and after-sales services to enhance customer retention and satisfaction. Its value proposition includes a wide brand portfolio, strong digital integration via its Yongda Auto APP, innovative battery recycling services, and a commitment to quality, efficiency, and sustainability. The company differentiates itself through its extensive dealership network, customer lifecycle management, and proactive adoption of AI and digital technologies.
